title: ZRPG | a goofy oldschool inspired MMORPG made with Claude - VERY EARLY LOOK
author: Final_Peak_797
selftext:
[ZRPG \[Working TITLE\] - PRE ALPHA ENGINE TRAILER](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=IvcpraujOWk)   
  
First game project here. . . made with 3js. Runs on WEBGPU. One click to play! I do apologize for not doing purely gameplay but everything is in engine with current game assets. This is the "friends and family" early sneak peak. **Best glimpse at 1:10 for anyone who reasonably would be just trying to see that.**   
  
The goal is a light "friendslop" RPG full of unique gear, weird characters, pop culture references, and a blend of medieval mixed with modern culture.   
  
The bosses are fully made in blender. I have standalone tools for creatures, npcs, weapons, armour etc. .. that mimic the blender procedural node process. FX maker. Map editor. Texture editor. . . etc. . The animation editor is just click and drag bones with keyframes. All simple html files that pull up in my web browser. Claude seems to do really well with small modular pieces vs trying to understand the ENTIRE project every time anything gets done. I'm sure I'm taking myself a little too seriously here, but this has been very fun getting to cosplay as a game dev. 

I'm really eager for feedback as well as all criticism. Please stay tuned. Thanks for your time!!
